instruction.vi: Chuẩn bị 1 phút rồi nói 1–2 phút; ghi âm và tự nghe lại.

questions.prompt_en: Describe a place where you would like to live. You should say: where it is; what the home is like; who you would live with; why it suits you.
questions.prompt_vi: Part 2: chuẩn bị 60 giây, nói tối đa 2 phút.

answer.model_en: I would like to live in a small apartment close to a park in a quiet part of the city. I do not need a very large place, but I would want enough room to work, relax and invite friends over. The apartment would probably have two bedrooms, a bright living room and a balcony with a few plants. I think natural light is important because I spend quite a lot of time indoors. I would live there with a family member, so we could share the household jobs and meals. The main reason I prefer this kind of home is convenience. I could walk to a supermarket and use public transport instead of driving everywhere. At the same time, the park would give me somewhere to exercise after a busy day. I once stayed in an apartment near a busy road, and I found the traffic noise quite tiring. That experience made me realise how valuable a peaceful neighbourhood can be. I would also enjoy knowing some of my neighbours, although I would still want privacy. Overall, this home would not be luxurious, but it would fit my lifestyle and make everyday routines easier.

questions.explanation_vi: Mẫu chỉ để tham khảo, không bắt buộc học thuộc. Đối chiếu bốn tiêu chí nói.
